# Native 0.5.2 business fixtures

Generated from the npm 0.5.2 published workflow and SDK APIs. All User approvals and Agent reports are explicitly simulated fixture inputs. These records establish serialized protocol and business ownership, not real user authorization or model quality.

The nine basic v1–v3 frontiers contain pending, claimed-but-unexecuted checks or Shape revalidation. Three Supervisor fixtures cover pending children, a mixed running Builder, and a repair-only wait after an actual failing Node command. Three later fixtures preserve a running Supervisor prepare, successful integration repair followed by pending checks, and pending child Archive with its original check-action reference. There are fifteen fixtures in total.

Current tests and public CLI probes preserve the original Run, Action input/inputHash, claim, accepted outcomes and approval Waits. Retired check scheduling may be cancelled without inventing an outcome or stop receipt. A pending original business task continues through its original claim. Full probe provenance and limitations are recorded in `docs/research/2026-11-10-native-platform-execution-retirement.zh.md`. No Eval, model, push or remote delivery was run. Preserve these frozen records when changing the upgrade adapter.
